arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

translations.en.sahih: By the sky and the night comer -
translations.en.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
translations.en.yusufali: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
translations.id.indonesian: Demi langit dan yang datang pada malam hari,

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
translations.en.pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
translations.id.indonesian: tahukah kamu apakah yang datang pada malam hari itu?

translations.en.yusufali: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-

arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ

translations.en.sahih: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
translations.en.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
translations.en.yusufali: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
translations.id.indonesian: tidak ada suatu jiwapun (diri) melainkan ada penjaganya.

translations.en.sahih: So let man observe from what he was created.
translations.en.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
translations.en.yusufali: Now let man but think from what he is created!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka hendaklah manusia memperhatikan dari apakah dia diciptakan?

translations.en.sahih: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
translations.en.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
translations.en.yusufali: He is created from a drop emitted-
translations.id.indonesian: Dia diciptakan dari air yang dipancarkan,

translations.en.sahih: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
translations.en.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
translations.en.yusufali: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
translations.id.indonesian: yang keluar dari antara tulang sulbi laki-laki dan tulang dada perempuan.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
translations.en.yusufali: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar kuasa untuk mengembalikannya (hidup sesudah mati).

translations.en.sahih: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,

arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
transliteration: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir

translations.en.sahih: Then man will have no power or any helper.
translations.en.pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
translations.en.yusufali: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
translations.id.indonesian: maka sekali-kali tidak ada bagi manusia itu suatu kekuatanpun dan tidak (pula) seorang penolong.

translations.en.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar firman yang memisahkan antara yang hak dan yang bathil.

translations.en.yusufali: It is not a thing for amusement.
translations.id.indonesian: dan sekali-kali bukanlah dia senda gurau.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
translations.en.yusufali: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang kafir itu merencanakan tipu daya yang jahat dengan sebenar-benarnya.

translations.en.sahih: But I am planning a plan.
translations.en.pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).
translations.en.yusufali: And I am planning a scheme.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Akupun membuat rencana (pula) dengan sebenar-benarnya.

translations.en.sahih: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
translations.en.pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
translations.id.indonesian: Karena itu beri tangguhlah orang-orang kafir itu yaitu beri tangguhlah mereka itu barang sebentar.
